title: BLACKRIDGE
short_description: Night-rain modern-military FPS in Meridian Ward, Zarov — a full campaign mission plus three PVP modes across three arenas: SKIRMISH 5v5, CAPTURE THE FLAG, and FREE-FOR-ALL, ten operators a match, and every one of them plays to win.
description:
One game, four ways to fight, all under the same night storm.

CAMPAIGN — RAVEN 2-1, you are going in alone. Meridian Ward is a blacked-out harbor district held by Vektor Ancile private military contractors. Work the infiltration from the docks, take the plaza, and reach the CINDERLOCK uplink before exfil closes. One mission, six beats, checkpoint respawns.

PVP — three arenas, each hosting all three modes at ten operators a match: you, your team and the opposition, all of them knowing each mode's full rules and fighting to win. Pick your ground before you deploy:
- LANTERNWALK — the harbour carve, shipping containers and lantern-lit arcades through the ward's densest blocks.
- SWITCHYARD — a tram depot: a covered running shed between two stabling yards, standing cars and gantries for cover, boarding platforms you fight across.
- SALTMARKET — a covered market: one great hall under a gallery walkway, wrapped in narrow rows of shuttered stalls and blind corners.
- SKIRMISH — 5v5 team deathmatch, AMBER vs SLATE. First to 50 kills or best score at 8:00; overtime is sudden death.
- CAPTURE THE FLAG — 5v5, mirrored flag rooms, 3 captures to win. Carriers get escorted, runners get cut off.
- FREE-FOR-ALL — every operator for themselves, 10-way, first to 25 kills.

Five original weapons carry every mode: the M-72 Warden full-auto rifle, the suppressed KS-23 Vesper for close work, the B-12 Breaker pump shotgun, the LR-1 Corvus scoped marksman rifle, and the GS-9 Pike sidearm. Matches are a pistol start: find rifles on glowing weapon racks, take the guns your victims drop, and switch with 1-5. String kills together without dying and earn a Signal Sweep recon drone that pings every enemy (3), a mortar strike (5), an airstrike (7) or an orbital barrage (10). Movement is modern-military: sprint, slide, mantle, aim-down-sights, and frag grenades you can cook. Every operator you face plays like a veteran — no wallhacks, no aimbots: they trade kills, flank when you hold a lane, suppress when you camp, and call every move aloud. There is no difficulty dial in PVP; the fight is always the same fight. Hold TAB for the live scoreboard.

Plays on phones and tablets too: landscape, with a move stick, drag-to-look, fire-and-aim button and tap-to-call killstreaks.
controls_keyboard: WASD move · Mouse look · LMB fire · RMB aim · R reload · SHIFT sprint · CTRL crouch (slide while sprinting) · SPACE jump/mantle · 1-5 weapons (wheel cycles, Q last) · walk over guns/ammo to loot · 6/7/8/9 killstreaks (3/5/7/10 kills; 7-9 aim then click) · G grenade · F interact · TAB scoreboard (matches) · ESC pause
